stronger_corollary.label: DERIVED
stronger_corollary.statement: An eventual polynomial lower bound for either actual raw K=3 energy, or either unit native K=3 ground eigenvalue, implies RH. Consequently any off-line zero rules out every such eventual lower bound.
stronger_corollary.proof: Suppose Q_p(L)>=-C L^a eventually. Multiply by the exact positive L^9 or L^7 scale in the bound derivation and dominate the lower envelope by Cprime L^n on L>=1, with integer n>=0. For unit eigenvalues first multiply by the full positive norm polynomial N_p(L). The resulting scaled X_p plus that polynomial is an eventually nonnegative density. Its genuine safe Laplace transform differs from the complete transform in K4 only by a polynomial-tail transform, holomorphic on Re(s)>0, and an explicit finite-prefix entire function. The nonzero p0 singularity from K5 survives; the full positive-real continuation survives too. K6 therefore contradicts eventual nonnegativity using the existing positive-Laplace boundary theorem. This does not prove the lower bound itself.
